name: RoMath
description: RoMath is a Romanian mathematical reasoning benchmark suite comprising three datasets covering a range of mathematical domains and difficulty levels. It aims to improve non-English language models and promote multilingual AI development by focusing on Romanian, a low-resource language with unique linguistic features.
reputation: RoMath is a newer Romanian math reasoning benchmark that is useful for low-resource multilingual evaluation but is not yet as widely established as major English math benchmarks.
notes: Focuses on Romanian language, addressing limitations of Anglo-centric models and promoting resources beyond automatic translation.
